newsitem.title: USA: Ford expected to shed Budget Rent a Car - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Ford expected to shed Budget Rent a Car - WSJ.

text.p: In what would be the second sale of a major rental car company in less than a week, Ford Motor Co is expected to sell its Budget Rent a Car unit to a publicly traded group of Budget licensees, The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
The sale to Team Rental Group Inc for about $350 million could be announced as early as Thursday after a Ford board meeting, the newspaper said.
Earlier this week, Republic Industries Inc agreed to buy National Car Rental for $600 million.

The Journal said Ford also may explore the possibility of an initial public offering or sale of its Hertz Corp, the nation's top rental car company, which could fetch between $2.5 billion and $3 billion.
